Name: First Year Red Cabbage
Author: agh1353
Description:
I find it unfair that completing the community center requires relying on the unpredictable Travelling Cart. Even when I check "Guarantee First Year Completeable" I can never find the seeds at the cart when I find time to visit it. So I made this mod. They are twice as expensive as usual to discourage you from actually farming them, and there are only 5 grown cabbages in stock at the end of summer. This mod is most helpful for newer players or those who don't visit the cart that often.

This mod requires SMAPI, ShopTileFramework, and its' dependencies to work. https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005

Manifest.Name: (STF) First Year Red Cabbage
Manifest.Description: Adds overpriced Red Cabbage Seeds to Pierre's stock in the summer of the first year, as well as a few expensive Red Cabbages in the last week in case you missed the growth period.
